text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder and I have come to a<n>shrine.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I pray at a shrine, there's<n>something
important I like to keep in<n>mind.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. When we pray, it should be for<n>the sake of
others. Any benefit to<n>ourselves is only a happy
bonus.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The tradition goes that Japanese<n>deities respond
best to prayers for<n>the land and its people as a
whole.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I've been told it is improper to pray<n>only for
yourself.
choice_data_list: That's a nice way of thinking.
That's a nice way of thinking.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It's only one point of view, of course,<n>but I believe
the deities will take<n>notice if I honor it.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
According to an old Japanese saying,<n>compassion
for others is always<n>rewarded. I find it to be a
wonderful<n>sentiment. ♪
choice_data_list: I'll give it a shot, too.
I'll give it a shot, too.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you will? Then let's go offer our<n>prayers
together. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Reflecting carefully on Grass<n>Wonder's words, I
pray for the<n>prosperity of all Umamusume in their
races.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Whew... All done. The rest depends<n>on the gods'
temperament.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
One should always do their best... but<n>sometimes a
little divine aid is the<n>push you need. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Considering how committed she is to<n>doing her
best, I'm sure the gods will<n>provide their blessings.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Whew... We're all done now, but...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear. Perhaps the gods aren't in<n>the best of
moods?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The two of us run back to the<n>academy in the
pouring rain.
